section1.title: 1. Data We Collect
section1.body: When you create an account: your name, email address, and phone number. When you use the system: your club's operational data that you enter yourself (customers, players, bookings, invoices, attendance) — we do not collect any additional data about you or your customers beyond what you enter directly into the system.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
section2.body: We use your data only to operate the service: signing you in, displaying your club's data, issuing invoices, and sending email confirmation and password-reset messages. We do not sell your data or share it with any third party for marketing purposes.

section3.title: 3. Data Isolation Between Clubs
section3.body: Each club can only see its own data. The platform's technical architecture (database-level security policies) prevents any club from accessing another club's data, independent of the user interface.

section4.title: 4. Where Your Data Is Stored
section4.body: Data is stored with a cloud services provider (Supabase) over an encrypted connection. We retain your data for as long as your account is active; when you close your account, you may request deletion of your data by contacting us.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights
section5.bodyPrefix: You may at any time request to view, correct, or delete your data by contacting us via the

section1.title: 1. About the Service
section1.body: Mal3aby is an operations management platform for sports clubs and academies — bookings, invoices and payments, players and subscriptions, QR-based attendance, and reports. By using the service, you agree to these terms.

section2.title: 2. Account and Subscription
section2.body: Every new club starts with a 7-day free trial that requires no credit card, granted once per user. After the trial ends, continuing to use the platform requires a paid subscription activated by contacting the Mal3aby team. You are responsible for the accuracy of your club's data and for keeping your account's login credentials confidential.

section3.title: 3. Data You Enter
section3.body: Customer, player, booking, and invoice data that you enter into your system remains the property of you and your club. We store it only to operate the service and do not use it for any other purpose beyond what is described in the Privacy Policy.

section4.title: 4. Payments and Invoices
section4.body: Platform subscription fees are charged according to the plan the club selects, and do not include the club's own payments from its customers (those are managed within your own system and do not pass through Mal3aby). No amount is ever deducted automatically without your explicit confirmation.

section5.title: 5. Termination of Service
section5.body: You may stop using the platform at any time by contacting us. We reserve the right to suspend access in cases of clear misuse of the service or non-payment of the subscription after the agreed grace period.
